name: The Nation cryptic crossword No 3427
preamble: Puzzled? No more cross words! Read Kosman and Picciotto on “Solving The Nation’s Cryptic Puzzles.” Or watch this video.

clue.text: Composer's material: one supporting Annan even halfway

indicators.note: going only halfway through a word means keeping just its first half of letters

blocks.note: serge is a hard-wearing twilled cloth
the Roman numeral for one
to be pro something is to support it
Kofi Annan was the UN Secretary-General
the first half of the four-letter word

explanation.surface: A music note: a composer's material is a backing piece for Kofi Annan, delivered half-heartedly.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after Composer is the link 'is', so the composer is built from the rest. This is the composer of Peter and the Wolf, the theme answer at 29 Across.
explanation.definitionFit: Sergei Prokofiev was a Russian composer of symphonies, ballets and the children's piece Peter and the Wolf.

clue.text: Copper stored in dry safe

indicators.note: something stored in a place is held inside it

blocks.note: sere means dried up and withered
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: Copper kept in a dry strongbox.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dry safe' suggests a strongbox, but safe is the adjective and the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something secure is protected from danger or harm, which is what safe means.

clue.text: Argue about a male descendent

blocks.note: re means about or concerning
taken as written
a son is a male child

explanation.surface: Quarrelling over a son and heir.
explanation.definitionFit: To reason is to argue a point logically, presenting a case step by step.

clue.text: Key snippet of code missing from core

indicators.note: a snippet is a tiny clipping, here just the opening letter of the word that follows
a thing missing from another has been taken out of it

blocks.note: the core of something is its center, in American spelling
the initial letter of the word

explanation.surface: A programmer finding a crucial fragment of code gone from the core software.
explanation.walkthrough: The Nation is American, so the core is CENTER rather than centre.
explanation.definitionFit: Enter is the keyboard key pressed to confirm a command or start a new line.

clue.text: Looking up, I see part of an epitaph in which there's a pole for fish

indicators.note: a phrase in which there is something holds that thing inside it
in a down entry, looking up means reading from the bottom to the top

blocks.note: ah is the exclamation of sudden understanding
the indefinite article
RIP, rest in peace, is the classic gravestone epitaph
N is the north pole

explanation.surface: Someone reading an inscription on a tombstone that mentions a fishing pole.
explanation.walkthrough: The pole sits between the exclamation and the epitaph before the whole string is turned upward. 'Pole for fish' looks like a fishing rod, but the definition is just fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The piranha is a sharp-toothed freshwater fish of South American rivers.

clue.text: Blue childbirth?

definitions.note: a punning noun phrase: an ob scene, a scene in obstetrics

blocks.note: first meaning: indecent, smutty
second meaning, read as two words: a scene from the obstetrics ward, ob being short for obstetrics

explanation.walkthrough: Blue looks like sadness or colour, as in postnatal blues. The question mark flags that the second reading splits the answer into OB SCENE, a delivery-room scene.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue jokes or films are indecent ones, and obscene means offensively indecent.

clue.text: Duck out before obscuring everyone's faces

indicators.note: a word's face is its front, so only the opening letter of each word counts

blocks.note: the initial letter of each of the four words

explanation.surface: Someone ducks away before covering everybody's faces.
explanation.walkthrough: Duck is a theme definition from 29 Across: in Peter and the Wolf the duck is played by the oboe.
explanation.definitionFit: In Prokofiev's piece each character has an instrument, and the duck's melody is given to the oboe.

clue.text: Little devil reportedly got high in jail

indicators.note: what is reported is passed on by word of mouth, so it is the sound that counts

blocks.note: an imp is a small mischievous demon
having got high, something has risen

explanation.surface: A young rascal said to have got stoned while locked up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Got high' suggests drugs, but it means climbed, as in has risen.
explanation.definitionFit: To imprison someone is to lock them up, which is to jail them.

clue.text: Boy tossed oil into French wines

indicators.note: tossing throws things about, so the letters of the next word land in a new order
putting something into another places it inside

blocks.note: taken as written
vins is French for wines

explanation.surface: A lad throwing oil into some French wine.
explanation.walkthrough: Boy is a theme definition from 29 Across: Peter, the boy, is played by the string section.
explanation.definitionFit: In Peter and the Wolf the boy Peter's theme is played by the strings, led by the violins.

clue.text: Care of flower: It can protect a tabletop

blocks.note: c/o is the postal abbreviation for care of
an aster is a daisy-like flower

explanation.surface: Looks like an address on a florist's delivery followed by a note about furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: A coaster is a small mat set under a glass so the drink does not mark the table.

clue.text: Coors brew involves irrational sign

indicators.note: brewing stirs ingredients up, so the brand name's letters are mixed
to involve is to take something in, so one part sits inside the other

blocks.note: the beer brand, taken letter for letter
pi is the best-known irrational number

explanation.surface: A can of Coors beer somehow hiding an unreasonable omen.
explanation.walkthrough: Coors is an American beer; 'irrational' is a noun here, the irrational number pi.
explanation.definitionFit: Scorpio is one of the twelve signs of the zodiac, the scorpion.

clue.text: River travel disrupted by Baroque organ

indicators.note: something disrupted has an intruder breaking into its middle
baroque means ornate and convoluted, so the following word's letters are twisted

blocks.note: to ride is to travel on a horse or vehicle
taken as written

explanation.surface: A river trip interrupted by the sound of an ornate 17th-century church organ.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Baroque organ' reads as a period instrument, but Baroque only scrambles the word after it, which then goes inside the word for travel.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rio Grande is the river forming much of the border between the United States and Mexico.

clue.text: Virtual assistant overthrowing goddess

indicators.note: overthrowing turns something upside down, so the goddess is read backwards

blocks.note: Iris is the Greek goddess of the rainbow

explanation.surface: A phone's voice assistant staging a coup against a deity.
explanation.definitionFit: Siri is the voice-controlled virtual assistant on Apple devices.

clue.text: Pigpen close to home is an eyesore?

indicators.note: the close of a word is its end, so only the last letter is kept

blocks.note: a sty is a pen for pigs
the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: Complaining that the neighbour's pigsty next to the house spoils the view.
explanation.walkthrough: Eyesore is meant literally: a sore on the eye. The question mark flags that twist.
explanation.definitionFit: A stye is an inflamed swelling on the eyelid, literally a sore on the eye.

clue.text: Guys get older with a riot's wild threesome

indicators.note: wild means out of control, so the following letters run in a new order

blocks.note: guys are men
to age is to get older
taken as written
the letters of riot plus the s

explanation.surface: Ageing men joining a riotous, wild trio.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase is French, so a and trois are French words; riot's must contribute its s.
explanation.definitionFit: A ménage à trois is a household or romantic arrangement involving three people.

clue.text: Pitcher almost married again, but turned back

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the final letter is dropped
turning back means facing the other way, so the letters run backwards

blocks.note: to rewed is to marry again

explanation.surface: A baseball pitcher who nearly remarried but backed out.
explanation.walkthrough: Pitcher suggests baseball, but it is a jug.
explanation.definitionFit: A ewer is a large jug with a wide spout, a kind of pitcher for water.

clue.text: Antelope understood broadcast

indicators.note: a broadcast is heard over the air, so the word is taken by its sound

blocks.note: understood is knew, said with a silent k

explanation.surface: An antelope that grasped what was on the radio.
explanation.definitionFit: The gnu, or wildebeest, is a large African antelope.

clue.text: Doctor can't rile cat

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so the letters are altered in order

blocks.note: taken as written, apostrophe dropped
taken as written

explanation.surface: A vet unable to annoy a cat.
explanation.walkthrough: Cat is a theme definition from 29 Across: in Peter and the Wolf the cat is played by the clarinet.
explanation.definitionFit: Prokofiev gives the stealthy cat its theme on the clarinet in low register.

clue.text: Hop, skip, or jump during quiet period when cutting tangled ties — that's a magical solution

indicators.note: something happening during a period falls inside it
a thing cutting another slices into its middle
tangled things are knotted out of order, so these letters are rearranged

blocks.note: each of the three is an example of a verb
a lull is a calm spell
taken as written

explanation.surface: Playground games pause, someone untangles knots, and it all resolves like magic.
explanation.walkthrough: Hop, skip and jump look like actions to do, but they stand for the word class all three belong to; that goes in the quiet period, which in turn cuts the scrambled ties.
explanation.definitionFit: Folklore says only a silver bullet kills a werewolf, so the phrase means a simple, almost magic fix for a hard problem.

clue.text: Begin to deposit pests in an elevator

indicators.note: an elevator carries things upward, and in a down entry going up reads backwards

blocks.note: to put is to set down
rats are vermin

explanation.surface: Someone about to set loose vermin in a lift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In an elevator' looks like a location, but it only lifts the letters, so they read bottom to top.
explanation.definitionFit: To start up is to begin, as with an engine or a business.

clue.text: Fool is in favor with grandfather

indicators.note: one thing that is in another sits inside it

blocks.note: a boon is a favor granted
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A silly person in Grandpa's good books.
explanation.walkthrough: Grandfather is a theme definition from 29 Across: Peter's grumpy grandfather is played by the bassoon.
explanation.definitionFit: In Peter and the Wolf the grandfather's gruff theme is given to the bassoon.

clue.text: Raised request to break up instrument making watches

indicators.note: breaking something up opens a gap in it for another part to sit in
raised means lifted, and in a down entry lifting reads the letters bottom to top

blocks.note: a tool is an implement or instrument
to ask is to request

explanation.surface: A raised hand asking to dismantle a device that makes clocks.
explanation.walkthrough: In a puzzle about Peter and the Wolf, instrument suggests music, but it is a tool; and watches is a verb, not timepieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To watch something is to observe it, which is to look at it.

clue.text: Sounds of impact and disapproval for woody grass

blocks.note: bam is the noise of a blow
boo is the jeer of disapproval

explanation.surface: A crash and a jeer from a stand of tall grass.
explanation.definitionFit: Bamboo is a giant grass whose hollow stems are woody and hard.

clue.text: The woman's enemy points toward the top belonging to this…

indicators.note: pointing toward the top of a down entry means running from bottom to top

blocks.note: her is the possessive for a woman
a foe is an enemy

explanation.surface: A woman's adversary gesturing upward at the summit.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis runs into 25 Down; the definition ends at this.
explanation.definitionFit: Hereof is a formal word meaning of this or concerning this, as in legal documents.

clue.text: Measure someone with a pain in the ear

indicators.note: what is in the ear is heard rather than read, so spelling gives way to sound

blocks.note: someone who aches is an acher

explanation.surface: Sizing up a patient who has earache.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A pain in the ear' reads as earache, but 'in the ear' is the sound signal applied to someone with a pain.
explanation.definitionFit: An acre is a unit of land area, 4,840 square yards.

clue.text: San Francisco limiting current with body of water that is supposedly unique

definitions.note: a relative clause standing for the noun: a thing that is supposedly unique

indicators.note: limiting something means fencing it in on both sides

blocks.note: SF is the standard abbreviation for the city
current means present, happening now
a lake is an inland body of water

explanation.surface: San Francisco hemming in a current beside a one-of-a-kind body of water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Current' looks like a flow of water next to 'body of water', but it means present time.
explanation.definitionFit: It is said that no two snowflakes are alike, so each is supposedly one of a kind.

clue.text: …glass bird

blocks.note: first meaning: a tall narrow champagne glass
second meaning: the instrument that plays the bird in Peter and the Wolf

explanation.walkthrough: Bird is a theme definition from 29 Across: the bird's chirping theme is played by this instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A flute is both a slender stemmed glass for sparkling wine and the woodwind that voices the bird.

clue.text: Eldest child, perhaps, with outspoken manner

indicators.note: outspoken here means spoken out loud, so the next word counts by its sound

blocks.note: an air is a manner or bearing

explanation.surface: A firstborn child with a blunt way of talking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outspoken manner' reads as bluntness; outspoken just means said aloud.
explanation.definitionFit: The eldest child is often the heir, the one who inherits a title or estate.

clue.text: Fruit train interrupting dance

indicators.note: to interrupt is to break into the middle of something

blocks.note: the tango is an Argentine dance
an el is an elevated railway, as in Chicago

explanation.surface: A train rattling past breaks up a dance floor.
explanation.walkthrough: EL is American: Chicago's elevated trains are called the El.
explanation.definitionFit: A tangelo is a citrus fruit, a hybrid of tangerine and pomelo or grapefruit.

clue.text: Second fall trip

blocks.note: s is the abbreviation for second
a tumble is a fall

explanation.surface: A second fall on a journey, or an autumn holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trip' and 'fall' suggest an autumn journey, but trip is a verb: to stumble.
explanation.definitionFit: To trip is to catch your foot and lose your balance, which is to stumble.

clue.text: Draftee won't help changing musical work that provides a guide to the definitions in five of this puzzle's clues

definitions.text: musical work that provides a guide to the definitions in five of this puzzle's clues

indicators.note: changing the words means their letters are made into something new

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written, apostrophe dropped
taken as written

explanation.surface: A conscript refusing to assist with a changing piece of music.
explanation.walkthrough: In Prokofiev's piece each character has an instrument, and five clues use the character as definition: bird is FLUTE, duck OBOE, cat CLARINET, grandfather BASSOON, and the boy Peter VIOLINS.
explanation.definitionFit: Peter and the Wolf is Prokofiev's 1936 narrated children's piece in which each character is played by an instrument.
